claims.claim: MCP separates connection lifecycle, capability negotiation, session control, and server features such as tools, resources, and prompts over JSON-RPC.
claims.applicability: For Tool-provider-storage ownership is not closed-world and Migration owner-map boundary is preserved, shared tool, provider, skill, or plugin vocabulary does not establish one authority or lifecycle.

claims.claim: JSON Schema validation supplies structural assertions but does not itself define ownership, invocation lifecycle, authorization, recovery, or user-visible outcomes.
claims.applicability: This supports the shared_subsystem_distinct judgment while preserving the packet evidence for separate owner and consumer contracts.

decisions.rationale: The packet establishes two related features in the same owner domain, but their exact owner assignments, source units, feature kinds, specification states, outcomes, and failure obligations remain distinct. Shared vocabulary, adjacency, or participation in one workflow does not satisfy the five-part merge rule.
decisions.authority_lifecycle_outcome_state_failur: Authority: OPF::A005OM-0021::PF-0159 is assigned to A005OM-0021 from Plans/OpenCode_Deep_Extraction.md, while OPF::A005OM-0022::PF-0132 is assigned to A005OM-0022 from Plans/feature-list.md. Lifecycle/state: the first is cross_cutting_concern/under_specified/high; the second is tool/well_specified/low. Outcome/failure: first summary="Validated packet observation, pending independent conclusion testing: Several owner documents are named, but `related owners` is open-ended and no field-level producer/consumer mapping, precedence, or integration oracle is supplied."; second summary="FL-025 routes all named feature families to current owners and preserves the deprecated cancel alias and Feature Seam naming boundaries.". These records do not establish identical authority, lifecycle, user outcome, state boundary, and failure semantics.
supporting_evidence: Endpoint OPF::A005OM-0021::PF-0159: title="Tool-provider-storage ownership is not closed-world"; owner=A005OM-0021; domain=tools_integrations_mcp; kinds=cross_cutting_concern; spec_state=under_specified; risk=high; source_documents=Plans/OpenCode_Deep_Extraction.md; source_units=PLANUNIT:ODE-055,SEMANTIC:PLANUNIT:ODE-055; summary=Validated packet observation, pending independent conclusion testing: Several owner documents are named, but `related owners` is open-ended and no field-level producer/consumer mapping, precedence, or integration oracle is supplied.

Endpoint OPF::A005OM-0022::PF-0132: title="Tools and approval summaries defer to current owners"; owner=A005OM-0022; domain=tools_integrations_mcp; kinds=tool; spec_state=well_specified; risk=low; source_documents=Plans/feature-list.md; source_units=PLANUNIT:FL-025,SEMANTIC:PLANUNIT:FL-025; summary=FL-025 routes all named feature families to current owners and preserves the deprecated cancel alias and Feature Seam naming boundaries.

Prior candidate evidence A005CS-0032/CSDEC::A005CS-0032::0049 (primary, disposition=related_but_distinct, confidence=0.97): Compared all 162 packet comparators. General owner-map rows do not close the field-level tool-provider-storage producer and consumer map.

Prior candidate evidence A005CSS-0037/SHADOWDEC::A005CSS-0037::0024 (reverse_shadow, disposition=related_but_distinct, confidence=0.95): Exhaustive review of all 164 comparator features found no merge-equivalent comparator. Plausible but distinct neighbors are OPF::A005OM-0021::PF-0158 (Formatter, skill, plugin, and model ownership is explicit); OPF::A005OM-0021::PF-0159 (Tool-provider-storage ownership is not closed-world); each differs in product authority, lifecycle or state boundary, user outcome, or failure semantics, and any overlap is adjacency, dependency, shared vocabulary, or umbrella/member structure.
counterevidence: The endpoints share the owner domain tools_integrations_mcp and were normalized into one seam; this establishes plausible overlap or flow adjacency but not feature identity.
